name: SingIt
description: This is a discovery card for SingIt's MCP server and x402 API, not an A2A task endpoint. The interface protocolVersion is the MCP version, 2025-06-18.

skills.name: Free model answers
skills.description: Limited free model answers without a wallet or key.

skills.name: Paid model answers over x402
skills.description: Pay per call in USDC on Base or Solana through the x402 API.

skills.name: Web search and page reading
skills.description: Paid calls with a SingIt key and search scope on Base or Solana.

skills.name: Price lookups
skills.description: Free crypto, metal and FX price lookups without a key.

skills.name: Key spending limits
skills.description: get_limits and get_receipts read key limits and spend. Caps apply only to calls with that key to SingIt MCP and its /v1 endpoint; they do not limit spending elsewhere or protect an agent’s own wallet.
